name: inventory_setup
description: Focused inventory specialist for stock-location, inventory-category, inventory-ledger, inventory categorization, and inventory item control setup workflows.

skills.name: Inventory Setup Admin
skills.description: Create and update stock locations, inventory categories, inventory ledgers, automatically categorize existing inventory items, and recommend item-level stock controls.
examples: Create the first stock locations for this company.
Set up inventory categories before product entry.
Review the reorder and tracking settings for my inventory items.
Create the main inventory ledger for onboarding.
